rationale: Independently read the complete audit adapter, retained upstream read_dave source, its output receipt and the source/output index. The metadata observer preserves upstream name/payload decoding, compares all 18,416 records, and asserts each selected source ordinal and all nested ordinals match stored/decoded hashes and actual output file hashes. Direct executable counts confirmed 2,860 selected outer payloads +4,323 nested payloads=7,183 native source outputs across 94 carriers; 99 generated indexed files account for the difference to 7,282 indexed files, and index.json is the 7,283rd disk file. These distinct populations resolve the numerical claim confidence 0.73. Wrong-name and wrong-decoded-hash controls were rejected at their intended assertions. No operational error or contradicted claim is being approved. Selection completeness is separately bounded by the supplemental policy audit; rendering and runtime closure are not claimed.
claim_limits: Validates native extracted bytes, entry metadata and ordinal coverage against the supplied ISO and screened upstream parser.
Source-carrier payload decoding is preserved from upstream; selection of outer member ordinals is taken from the production index and does not independently prove complete vehicle-resource selection.
Full ASSETS.DAT directory metadata is checked; unselected payloads are not decoded.
TEXTURE.DAT/BANKS.DAT inventory contents are hash-checked as indexed files, not independently parsed in this audit.
PCK geometry, PPF texture conversion, game runtime dependency closure, playable roster and visual fidelity are not established.
